product_overview: AiChart is a multi-user intelligent trading platform for Binance that lets users chat with an expert AI agent, generate structured trade signals, and manage trading settings through a modern Arabic RTL interface. The system also supports conversations, market data, trade visibility, Telegram integration, and 24/7 monitoring for production use.
core_goals: Provide secure email/password and Telegram-based authentication with JWT sessions.
Enable users to chat with an AI market-analysis agent and receive streaming recommendations.
Allow users to generate structured trade plans through a guided signal wizard.
Persist conversations, user settings, and account profile data for continuity across sessions.
Expose trading and market data to support dashboards, charts, and execution workflows.
Support Arabic RTL front-end pages for login, chat, dashboard, and signal creation.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can create accounts, log in with email and password, and end sessions securely using JWT-based authentication.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with a new email/password -> Receive 200 with user created -> POST /api/auth/login with the same credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT-backed user session -> Access authenticated features with the session
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials -> User remains unauthenticated and cannot access protected endpoints
POST /api/auth/logout with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 ok -> Session cookie is cleared and subsequent protected requests require login

features.name: AI Chat Agent
features.description: Authenticated users can check agent readiness and send chat messages, including optional images, to a streaming Claude-powered assistant.
user_flows: GET /api/chat/status with a valid session -> Receive 200 with { ready: boolean, model: string } -> POST /api/chat with message, stream=true, and optional conversationId -> Receive 200 SSE events including delta, activity, and done

GET /api/chat/status when Anthropic is not configured -> Receive 200 with ready=false and inactive model state -> POST /api/chat with a valid request -> Receive error response because the Claude API key is missing
POST /api/chat without authentication -> Receive an authorization error because auth is required -> Chat stream is not started

features.name: Conversations
features.description: Users can create, list, and reopen saved chat conversations to continue prior discussions.
user_flows: POST /api/conversations with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with a new conversation object -> GET /api/conversations -> Receive 200 with the conversation included in the user list -> GET /api/conversations/{id} -> Receive 200 with the stored messages
GET /api/conversations without authentication -> Receive an authorization error -> Conversation list is not returned
GET /api/conversations/{id} for a conversation owned by another user or an invalid id -> Receive an error response or empty result according to access rules -> No conversation messages are exposed

features.name: Signals Wizard
features.description: Users can generate structured trade plans for Binance symbols through a guided wizard that consumes credits and returns recommendations.
user_flows: GET /api/instruments with a valid session and search criteria -> Receive 200 with Binance USDT trading pairs -> POST /api/signals/generate with symbol, style, riskPercent, capital, stopLossStyle, and notes -> Receive 200 with a recommendation result
POST /api/signals/generate with valid inputs but insufficient quota/credits -> Receive 429 Quota exceeded -> No signal plan is generated
GET /api/instruments without authentication -> Receive an authorization error -> Instrument list is not returned

features.name: User Profile and Settings
features.description: Users can view their account profile bundle and update trading settings, including linked services and quota information.
user_flows: GET /api/me with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 with user profile bundle including settings, limits, Binance status, and quota -> PATCH /api/settings with updated trading preferences -> Receive 200 with updated settings
PATCH /api/settings with invalid payload values -> Receive validation or update error -> Stored settings remain unchanged
GET /api/me without authentication -> Receive an authorization error -> Profile, limits, and quota are not returned

features.name: Trades and Market
features.description: Users can review trade history and load Binance market candlesticks for charting and trade analysis.
user_flows: GET /api/trades with a valid session -> Receive 200 with Trade[] -> GET /api/market/klines with the required market parameters -> Receive 200 with Kline[] for chart rendering
GET /api/trades without authentication -> Receive an authorization error -> Trade history is not returned
GET /api/market/klines with invalid or missing query parameters -> Receive an error response -> No candlestick data is returned

features.name: Frontend Pages
features.description: The platform provides authenticated Arabic RTL pages for chat, dashboard, and the signals wizard, plus a public login page.
user_flows: GET /login without authentication -> Receive 200 HTML page -> User submits credentials via POST /api/auth/login -> Receive 200 session -> GET /dashboard or GET /chat -> Receive 200 HTML page for the authenticated area
GET /dashboard without authentication -> Receive an authorization redirect or error -> Protected page content is not shown
GET /signals/new with an authenticated session -> Receive 200 HTML page for the 4-step wizard -> POST /api/signals/generate after completing the form -> Receive recommendation result
